description: Lists announced API shutdown dates for AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and other providers, with days left, the suggested replacement, the source page, and links to a cost comparison and a side-by-side test of the replacement where this site has them.

includePast.description: Include shutdowns whose date has passed

query.description: A model id such as 'gpt-4o' (only exact id matches, if any), or words that must all appear in the model ids or provider, such as 'anthropic'. Omitted: every model.

today.description: Date to count days from, YYYY-MM-DD. Omitted: today in UTC.

name: model_shutdowns

listChecked.description: Date the list was last checked against the providers' deprecation pages

permalink.description: A page on this site that shows this result, for a person to open

daysLeft.description: Negative once the date has passed

model.description: The model ids as the provider's deprecation page writes them

shutdownDate.description: When API calls naming the model stop working, YYYY-MM-DD

switchPage.description: This site's cost comparison for the move to the replacement

switchTestUrl.description: The browser test with both models picked, run with your own API key

title: AI model shutdown dates
